# CityBuzz

> A comprehensive business news aggregator covering startup funding, technology updates, market trends, and geopolitical impacts on global markets.

CityBuzz aggregates real-time business intelligence across multiple sectors including technology, energy, healthcare, mining, and cryptocurrency. The platform serves investors, entrepreneurs, and business professionals seeking curated news on market-moving developments, funding announcements, and industry disruptions.

## Core Services

- [CityBuzz Homepage](https://www.citybuzz.co): Homepage aggregating business news, startup funding, tech updates, and market trends
- [Share Your News](https://www.citybuzz.co/share): News submission and paid placement service for article publishing on citybuzz
